compliance_flags: Amazon MGM Studios ne aaj officially Robert Pattinson ko naya double o seven announce kiya.
Woh seven Bond banne wale saatve actor honge, aur Daniel Craig ki jagah lenge.
Film team direct karenge Dune wale Denis Villeneuve. Script likhenge Peaky Blinders wale Steven Knight.
Race mein Callum Turner, Josh O'Connor aur Nicholas Hoult jaise naam the. Bazi Pattinson ne maari.
Shooting agle saal shuru hone ki ummeed hai, aur release 2028 se pehle nahi.
Pattinson ne kaha, double o seven milna zindagi ka sabse bada samman hai.
hinglish_issues: "double o seven" instead of "007" or "Double O Seven"
groq.one_line_verdict: Script is full of unverified rumors and several Hinglish awkward phrases; no number mismatches but needs compliance and language polishing.
